# Get all playlists (check for more pages)
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total playlists: {len(all_playlists)}")
print([p['title'] for p in all_playlists])
